interfaces: StoredEvidenceRecord { lineageId, sequence, status, storedAt, payload }
RecordResult = { ok: true, record: StoredEvidenceRecord } | { ok: false, rejection: EvidenceRejection }
RevisionCheckResult = { status: 'CURRENT', record } | { status: 'REVISION_MISMATCH', record, expectedRevisionIdentity } | { status: 'NOT_FOUND' }
durable records: schemas/v1/validation-evidence.schema.json v1.0.0, schemas/v1/review-result.schema.json v1.1.0, schemas/v1/merge-evidence.schema.json v1.0.0

behavioralConstraints: record() accepts only payloads whose schemaId is a supported evidence schema and whose schemaVersion matches the reader's exact supported version

record() validates the full payload against the corresponding schemas/v1/*.schema.json document, including $ref-resolved nested shapes and role/outcome-conditioned allOf/if/then requirements, before acceptance

a lineage is derived deterministically from taskId plus validatorId for validation-evidence records, taskId plus role for review-result records, or taskId alone for merge-evidence records, so the three record kinds never collide even for the same taskId
every accepted record is written to a new, never-reused sequence file within its lineage; no existing record file is ever overwritten or deleted

getCurrent returns the highest-sequence record for a lineage; getHistory returns every record for a lineage in sequence order with status CURRENT on the last entry and SUPERSEDED on all earlier entries

checkRevision distinguishes CURRENT (matches expectedRevisionIdentity), REVISION_MISMATCH (a current record exists but for a different revision), and NOT_FOUND (no record exists for the lineage) so a caller can never mistake evidence as applying to a revision it was not recorded against

the schema validator's supported JSON Schema subset includes the integer type and the minimum/maximum numeric keywords (BOOT-025), so a numeric field declared type: integer with a minimum rejects a fractional, zero, or out-of-range value at record() time, not only in the separate Python fixture validator
invariants: the store performs no lifecycle state transition
the store performs no review execution and no merge-readiness computation
the store requires no network access to persist or query records
persistence is local-filesystem based and fully deterministic given the same sequence of record() calls
a record rejected by schema validation is never persisted
examples: recording BOOT-014's ValidationRunResult-derived ipt.validation-evidence for a task/validator pair and reading it back via getCurrent
recording a second ipt.validation-evidence for the same task/validator at a newer revisionIdentity leaves the first record queryable via getHistory as SUPERSEDED
recording ipt.review-result documents for Developer, QA, Architect, UAT/Product, and MergeController roles on the same task keeps five independent current lineages
checkRevision against a stale expectedRevisionIdentity returns REVISION_MISMATCH carrying both the current record and the mismatched expectation

recording one ipt.merge-evidence document for a task's controlled merge (BOOT-025) and reading it back via getCurrent(mergeEvidenceLineageId(taskId)) never collides with that same task's ipt.validation-evidence or ipt.review-result lineages
edgeCases: a non-object payload is rejected as INVALID_PAYLOAD
an unrecognized schemaId is rejected as UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_ID
a recognized schemaId with an unsupported schemaVersion is rejected as UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
a review-result with outcome FAIL or BLOCKED but no nonPass detail is rejected by the schema's allOf/if/then requirement
querying a lineage that has never received a record returns null from getCurrent, an empty array from getHistory, and NOT_FOUND from checkRevision

expectations: BOOT-014 ValidationRunResult/ValidatorResult data can be persisted as revision-bound ipt.validation-evidence and read back to gate lifecycle advancement
acceptedRanges: a RecordResult with ok:true and a CURRENT StoredEvidenceRecord
a RecordResult with ok:false and a structured EvidenceRejection
requiredReachableRanges: successful record and read-back for a task/validator lineage
REVISION_MISMATCH when the gate's expected revision differs from the recorded one

expectations: QA/Architecture/UAT/product/MergeController ipt.review-result records can be persisted per task/role lineage without colliding with validation-evidence lineages for the same task
acceptedRanges: a RecordResult with ok:true and a CURRENT StoredEvidenceRecord for a role lineage
requiredReachableRanges: one current review-result per role per task
prior review-result revisions for the same role remain queryable as SUPERSEDED history

expectations: BOOT-025 can persist one ipt.merge-evidence record per task via mergeEvidenceLineageId(taskId) immediately after a merge is confirmed, and read it back via getCurrent both to finish interrupted post-merge bookkeeping and to answer a repeated call for an already-DONE task idempotently
acceptedRanges: a RecordResult with ok:true and a CURRENT StoredEvidenceRecord for the task's merge lineage
a RecordResult with ok:false and a structured EvidenceRejection
requiredReachableRanges: one current merge-evidence record per task, read back byte-for-byte identical to what was recorded
